research_scope: Counter Skill acquisition-field audit — Punisher Shield.

acquisition.quest: Parallel Quest 129 — Frieza Force on the Hunt

ultimate_finish_required.reason: The reviewed evidence available for this audit establishes PQ129 as the acquisition quest but does not provide sufficiently explicit evidence tying the skill reward specifically to an Ultimate Finish. The repository therefore continues to avoid inferring a requirement.

usable_by_cac.reason: Future Warrior usability is documented in the existing evidence set.

audit_conclusion: No correction committed for Punisher Shield. The conservative null Ultimate Finish value is retained rather than converted to false without explicit reward-condition evidence.
